effects.display_name: Shared Scorpion/LongLegs native climbing, spawn status and melee
effects.actual_behavior: Four Monster actors share ONE tick helper. Writes arphexclimber=true; sprint iff both original blocks Y-.6 andY-1.6 empty. Only LongLegsTiny with LongLegs presence full-side30 copies CURRENT nearest LongLegs from a separate full-side80 query and its Living native target; no owner relation. Only LongLegs andTiny independently inclusive1..5000==5 request server selfSilk200/0. Striker/Larva do not pass that type gate. Parent-first native finalizeSpawn: Striker optional cosmetic shade plus independent1..2==2 attempts TWO unowned ScorpionLarvae at original XYZ/MOB_SUMMONED/zeroMotion, then climbradius1. Larva writes radius.9 then queue2: CURRENT Striker presence original20 only copies shade, not Strength; absence plus NEW1..2==2 requests selfStrength99999/0, with no alive/level/range recheck beyond server Living. LongLegs spawn1..3==2 requests selfStrength99999/0 and shade, independent1..2==2 attempts TWO Tiny LongLegs, radius1. Tiny spawn independent1..3==2 sameStrength, radius.7; not shade/Strength inherited from parent. Fixed two spawn calls are not scalar counts. Native melee allclock/LOS/strict squared distance: Striker attack6/speed1.2/lt1.44, Larva3/1.2/lt2.25 plus native leapY.5, LongLegs1/speed.6/lt1 with native knockback2, Tiny0/.6/lt.09 with knockback1. Zero base does not imply inactive native hurt/control; native Strength and parent damage pipeline retained. Striker/Larva target Player/Silverfish/Rabbit/Frog and retaliation; LongLegs/Tiny only Silverfish+retaliation plus FollowMob, not a Player acquisition goal. Existing global target-event movement and shared climbing are independent reused callbacks. Concrete potion/cloud/Poison, FALL/CACTUS/DROWN/LIGHTNING/WITHER/WITHER_SKULL reject; only Striker/Larva additionally IN_FIRE reject. Native fixed scales .9/.8/.9/.6, no Spider superclass or inherited Spider goals. Texture NBT; ordinary shade, particles and utility excluded. No poison payload inferred from species names.
